subject: partnerships with beans.ai
text:
Hi Jack,

I read about Beans.ai's partnership with Nauto. As someone who relies on
deliveries daily, a heartfelt thank you for making lives easier for drivers
on the ground! Though I'd reach out since we've been working with Motive &
Automotus on similar fleet & road-facing CV models.

A common complaint we hear is that internal tooling struggles with the
growing complexity of spatial + temporal data. We help by making
annotation of multimodal datasets (image, video, 3D etc) faster, more
accurate, and cost-efficient. That means better model performance in
safety critical use cases like navigation, driver safety, and curbside
logistics.

Quick context on Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced CV
and multimodal AI. We bring data curation, annotation, workflow mgmt &
model evaluation into one place, so teams can focus on building better
models.

Would love to explore how we could bring similar values to Beans.ai. Do you
have 20-min to chat? Happy to work around your schedule.
